fields.title: mof.gov.ws Samoa tender/award record
fields.description: One record per card. Shape depends on recordType: CURRENT_TENDER (listType=current, an open-tender card with title, closing date, agency, contact info, and document links) or TENDER_AWARD (listType=awards, a contract-award card with implementing agency, winning bidder(s)/amounts, and all competing bidders). A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a request fails or is unreachable.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: Which list this record came from: 'list:current' or 'list:awards'.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record, or 'none' on error.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on a failed run (blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

title.title: Title
title.description: CURRENT_TENDER only -- what is being procured.

closingDate.title: Closing date
closingDate.description: CURRENT_TENDER only -- upstream free-text bid submission deadline.

agency.title: Agency
agency.description: CURRENT_TENDER only -- the procuring government agency.

contactText.title: Contact info
contactText.description: CURRENT_TENDER only -- contact name(s), email(s), phone, and portal link, combined as upstream published them.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: CURRENT_TENDER only -- direct links to the tender's PDF/DOCX/XLS documents (advertisement, bidding document, annexes -- labels vary per tender), each {label, url}.

contract.title: Contract
contract.description: TENDER_AWARD only -- the awarded contract's name.

approvalDate.title: Approval date
approvalDate.description: TENDER_AWARD only -- upstream free-text award approval date.

implementingAgency.title: Implementing agency
implementingAgency.description: TENDER_AWARD only -- the government agency implementing the contract.

winningBiddersText.title: Winning bidder(s) and amounts
winningBiddersText.description: TENDER_AWARD only -- free text, sometimes multiple lines for multi-lot/multi-package contracts.

allBiddersText.title: All bidders
allBiddersText.description: TENDER_AWARD only -- every company that competed for this contract, as a comma-separated list.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both record types -- rows missing a given column render blank.
